INSERT INTO credit_accounts (account_id, available_htc, total_earned_htc)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $2)
        ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE
        SET available_htc   = credit_accounts.available_htc + $2,
            total_earned_htc = credit_accounts.total_earned_htc + $2,
            updated_at = now()
